name: Fisheye Fixer
paragraphs: Fisheye Fixer corrects a range of fisheye lens distortion.
Fisheye Fixer is a simple tool, but you can make it a pinch simpler and quicker with its four presets. Find them via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Fisheye Fixer look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
